The Group’s objectives when managing capital is to safeguard the Group’s ability to continue as
a going concern in order to provide returns for shareholders and benefits for other stakeholders
and to maintain an optimal capital structure to reduce the cost of capital. In order to maintain or
adjust the capital structure, the Group may adjust the amount of dividends paid to shareholders,
return capital to shareholders through repurchase of shares, issue new shares or sell assets to
reduce debt. Consistent with others in the industry and the requirements of the lenders, the
Group monitors the capital structure on the basis of gearing ratio.
